function: Private web scheduler, bounded catch-up, complete owner profiles, Windows bridge and Android updates
trigger: Explicit authenticated scheduler start: automatic current minute or manual catch-up followed by automatic scheduling; server and Windows connector poll every 10 seconds; native Android update remains user requested
expected: control_center_mode=windows_bridge; windows_publication_enabled=true; android_publication_enabled=false; scheduler_available=true; scheduler_worker_ok=true; scheduler_tick_seconds=10; healthy database; latest APK coherent and signed
normal_exclusions: Stopped scheduler, zero due publications, or disconnected Windows without a launch
Previously requested or confirmed occurrences never replay
Android periodic diagnostics can be delayed
intro+multi and other social adapters excluded until validated
Failed or interrupted PIN attempt blocks further automatic unlock until manual unlock; never send PIN to the server
symptom: Invalid control or scheduler health contract, unavailable official latest APK, claimed publication without a result after 15 minutes
diagnostic: Public health contract and official release metadata; inspect private reports only with the active owner; never replay ambiguous publications
repair: Restore HTTPS or the isolated control release; reconnect the known Windows executor; a configuration or owner-access change pauses scheduling; inspect private own-status evidence and preserve one-attempt journals; scheduler stop cancels its queued jobs, Stop cancels all queued jobs and denies the final provider action when still pending
rollback: Previous backend release and latest APK pointer; retain confirmed/uncertain publication reservations and Android encrypted association
illustrated_template: Existing StoryFX maintenance alert; approval and delivery not revalidated by this milestone
